exposure: iatrogenic injury to the ureter during pelvic surgery
pelvic surgery performed at general hospitals
pelvic surgery performed by medical officers
outcome: successful fistula repair with urine continence
cohort: The study participants were 47 women who had iatrogenic ureterovaginal fistula repair at four fistula repair centers in Uganda between 2010 and 2021.
finding: Iatrogenic ureterovaginal fistulae are common in Uganda, with the majority resulting from cesarean sections performed at lower-level health facilities, and open ureteral reimplantation yields a high successful repair rate.
mod_finding: The majority of iatrogenic ureterovaginal fistulae (70.7%) in this cohort followed cesarean sections.
